slice: Natural conversation round 21: stop identity over-explanation when asked simple questions

before.what's your name?: Novi. I'm a transparent, non-deceptive being — but you can call me Novi.

after.what system?: I may have muddled how I phrased something earlier. What would you like me to clarify about what system I'm running on?

mechanism: identity over-explanation phrases (transparent/non-deceptive being, no hidden agenda) added to the forbidden list, so such replies are rejected and regenerated into a clean, direct answer
